question: Identify process generating the waste
decision: Map to Schedule I process description (hw_streams.csv)

question: Identify the waste stream
decision: Compare with Schedule I waste list for that process

question: Listed in Schedule I?
decision: YES -> hazardous waste; code exactly as printed in Schedule I (never inferred)
if_insufficient: UNKNOWN - do not infer a code

question: If not listed: Schedule II characteristic test
decision: Class A TCLP > limit / Class B > limit / C1 fp < 60 C / C2 pH <=2 or >=12.5 or corrosion > 6.35 mm/yr / C3 reactive -> hazardous

question: Hazardous waste determination
decision: HAZARDOUS / NOT_HAZARDOUS (only if listed-test negative AND lab tests negative) / INSUFFICIENT_DATA

question: Authorisation
decision: Form 1 application -> Form 2 authorisation (APR-010); utilisation r.9 (APR-054)

question: Transport
decision: Transport per HOWM r.18 + CMVR r.129-137 where Table III goods (CMP-024)

question: Disposal / utilisation
decision: TSDF / authorised utiliser / co-processing as authorised
